intro: Need help with the Hospital Construction ERP? Reach the VGRAND Health Care support team through either channel below, or contact your project administrator for account access issues.
tip1: For account access, role, or permission issues, contact your project administrator first — they can reset your PIN or adjust your access.
tip2: Include your registered phone number and project name so we can locate your account quickly.
tip3: For OTP delivery problems, wait a minute and use "Resend OTP" on the sign-in screen before reaching out.
